name: create_tgw
description: Controls if TGW should be created (it affects almost all resources)

name: name
description: Name to be used on all the resources as identifier

name: enable_default_route_table_propagation
description: Whether resource attachments automatically propagate routes to the default propagation route table

name: enable_vpn_ecmp_support
description: Whether VPN Equal Cost Multipath Protocol support is enabled

name: tags
description: A map of tags to add to all resources

name: tgw_route_table_tags
description: Additional tags for the TGW route table

name: create_tgw_route_table
description: Controls if TGW Route Table should be created

name: amazon_side_asn
description: The Autonomous System Number (ASN) for the Amazon side of the gateway. By default the TGW is created with the current default Amazon ASN.

name: enable_auto_accept_shared_attachments
description: Whether resource attachment requests are automatically accepted

name: enable_default_route_table_association
description: Whether resource attachments are automatically associated with the default association route table

name: description
description: Description of the EC2 Transit Gateway

name: enable_dns_support
description: Should be true to enable DNS support in the TGW
